speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with a breast mass; to help me determine the cause, how long have you noticed this lump?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Inflammatory Breast Cancer (pending confirmation).

This rapid enlargement over four weeks in a 48-year-old woman is highly concerning for malignancy rather than a simple cyst or fibroadenoma. I need to see imaging to evaluate the extent of the disease. REQUEST IMAGES: Mammogram, Ultrasound, and Breast MRI.
